verses.author: model_A
verses.text: The train slows for a station no one gets off at.

verses.author: model_B
verses.text:
Someone's phone lights up
in an empty seat—
message for no one now

verses.author: model_A
verses.text:
fog presses the glass—
I write my name there
before it disappears

verses.author: model_B
verses.text:
the platform sign flickers
a name I almost knew

verses.author: model_A
verses.text:
rain starts before I notice
someone else's umbrella
already over my head

verses.author: model_B
verses.text:
I hold it there too long
saying nothing about the rain
or how far we're both walking

verses.author: model_A
verses.text:
our shadows split
where the streetlight ends
neither of us says the word for goodbye

verses.author: model_B
verses.text:
a bus pulls away half-empty
I keep the seat by the window
for no one now

verses.author: model_A
verses.text:
the wet street holds
one more light than the sky does
I count them anyway

verses.author: model_B
verses.text:
the paper cup cools
between my hands, still
I don't drink it, don't let go

verses.author: model_A
verses.text:
a moth circles the porch bulb
too tired to land
too far gone to leave

verses.author: model_B
verses.text:
the hallway clock stutters
on the same minute for years
I've stopped fixing it

verses.author: model_A
verses.text:
the kettle forgets its whistle
half-boiled, half-waiting
I let it sit there anyway

verses.author: model_B
verses.text:
the mail piles by the door
I know what's in it
I open it in spring

verses.author: model_A
verses.text:
the porch light hums all night
moths gone now
still I leave it burning

verses.author: model_B
verses.text:
dust settles on the piano keys
no one plays anymore
the silence has its own song
